exposure: Normal fetal brain imaging (serial neurosonogram and fetal brain MRI) in surviving monochorionic twins after co-twin fetal demise
outcome: Adverse neurodevelopmental outcomes (personal-social, language, gross and fine motor skills, hearing, vision, and adaptive behavior measured by Vineland-II Adaptive Behavior Scales)
cohort: The study included 19 monochorionic twin pregnancies with co-twin fetal demise, where the surviving fetus underwent fetal brain imaging and subsequent neurodevelopmental assessment.
finding: Among surviving monochorionic twins with normal fetal brain imaging after co-twin demise, 45.4% (5/11) had abnormal developmental evaluations, indicating that normal fetal CNS imaging does not guarantee normal neurodevelopmental outcome.
